guarantees.claim: When condition is false, app_digest_done is 0 and app_digest is assigned all zero.
guarantees.cond: any other state besides (st==StAppWait and absorbed_i is mubi4 True and lc_escalate_en_i is lc_tx False)

guarantees.claim: When st==StAppWait, absorbed_i is mubi4 True Strict, and lc_escalate_en_i is lc_tx False Strict, app_digest_done is assigned 1 and for each share i, app_digest[i] gets the lower AppDigestW bits of keccak_state_i[i].

assumptions.claim: absorbed_i must be a valid mubi4_t True encoding when the absorbing phase completes, otherwise app_digest_done will never assert.
assumptions.cond: when the design expects a digest output
assumptions.risk: Digest output stalled indefinitely, keymgr may deadlock.

assumptions.claim: lc_escalate_en_i must be a valid lc_tx_t encoding (True or False). If it is invalid, lc_tx_test_false_strict will return 0, preventing digest output forever.
assumptions.risk: System hang if lifecycle signal is not driven to a valid encoding.

assumptions.claim: keccak_state_i shares must hold valid, stable digest data when condition is true.

uncertain_points.claim: Comment says second digest entry is tied to 0 when masking is disabled, but this chunk directly copies keccak_state_i[i] for all shares. If masking is disabled, keccak_state_i[1] must be forced to 0 elsewhere; otherwise secret data may leak via app_digest[1].
uncertain_points.risk: Uninitialized or secret data from keccak state leaked on second share output.

uncertain_points.claim: If AppDigestW parameter exceeds the width of keccak_state_i entries, partial select [AppDigestW-1:0] would be out of range, causing synthesis/simulation error.
uncertain_points.risk: Simulation/synthesis fails, or silent wrap-around in some tools.

uncertain_points.claim: app_digest_done is a combinational pulse that deasserts when condition becomes false, and app_digest resets to zero. If the consumer does not capture on the exact cycle when done=1, it may miss the digest.
uncertain_points.cond: when condition transitions from true to false
uncertain_points.risk: Consumer could miss the done pulse, leading to loss of digest transfer.
